description: Domain ontology and architectural knowledge graph mapping IronForge AI fitness systems and Supabase database schema.

nodes.label: Profile (User)
nodes.description: Primary athlete profile linked 1-to-1 with Supabase auth.users.

nodes.label: BodyScan
nodes.description: Physique telemetry and computer vision scans tracking muscular symmetry and body composition.

nodes.label: MuscleRankings
nodes.description: Granular muscle tier evaluations (S, A, B, C) per muscle group generated from a body scan.

nodes.label: WorkoutRoutine
nodes.description: Hypertrophy training splits and periodized exercise schedules prioritized by lagging muscle tiers.

nodes.label: FridgeScan
nodes.description: Multimodal computer vision scan of refrigerator or pantry inventory.

nodes.label: FridgeIngredient
nodes.description: Raw food items and nutritional supplies parsed by computer vision or entered manually.

nodes.label: TargetMacros
nodes.description: Dynamic daily macronutrient quotas calculated from athlete biometrics and training goals.

nodes.label: SmartRecipes
nodes.description: AI-synthesized high-protein culinary recipes matching detected ingredients to macro goals.

properties.title: string

edges.description: A user profile possesses multiple periodic body scan telemetry records.
Computer vision analysis of a body scan produces muscle ranking tiers.
Lagging muscle rankings dictate the volume and exercise selection in workout routines.
A user configures and manages multiple active/historical workout routines.
Multimodal vision scans parse inventory into fridge ingredient rows.
A user maintains a live inventory of available food ingredients.
Available fridge ingredients provide the building blocks for smart recipes.
Daily target macros serve as optimization constraints when assembling recipes.
